test_title: PYST 84: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

The official agencies often struggle to contain the spreading of fake news.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**spreading**" instead of "**spread**."
 
• The word** "spread" **should be used in this context to properly convey the action of fake news dissemination.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**contain the spread of fake news**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The official agencies often struggle to contain the **spread** of fake news."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "often struggle to contain,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 1.
 
• **4: "The official agencies,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
